ValidationRule.description: US-06 AC2: full SAT pattern (letters, date and homoclave); 12 characters for companies, 13 for individuals.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Donation', NOT(ISBLANK(RFC__c)), OR(AND(ISPICKVAL(Person_Type__c, 'Company'), NOT(REGEX(RFC__c, '[A-ZÑ&]{3}[0-9]{2}(0[1-9]|1[0-2])(0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[01])[A-Z0-9]{2}[0-9A]'))), AND(ISPICKVAL(Person_Type__c, 'Individual'), NOT(REGEX(RFC__c, '[A-ZÑ&]{4}[0-9]{2}(0[1-9]|1[0-2])(0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[01])[A-Z0-9]{2}[0-9A]')))))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: El RFC no tiene un formato válido: 12 caracteres para persona moral y 13 para persona física, en mayúsculas.
